description: Check whether the mockzilla CLI is available — either on the system PATH, in the bridge's own cache (~/.cache/mockzilla-mcp/), or via a `go run` invocation. Call FIRST when the user wants to try mockzilla locally. If nothing resolves, the response carries `install_options`; suggest `install_cli` to the user and ask them which method (download / go-install / go-run) they prefer.
name: check_cli
